title: Pulling a model from Ollama and trying things out

cues.en: So, we're pretty much ready to give things a try, and I tried executing this code after the last lecture and before this one, and I had three mistakes.
cues.zh: 我們差不多可以試用了。我在上一堂結束後、這堂開始前執行程式，發現三個錯誤。

cues.en: I expected to have some, I often have mistakes when I'm working in Python because I'm used to working in a strongly-typed, compiled language far more frequently.
cues.zh: 我本來就預期會有錯。寫 Python 時我常犯錯，因為平常更常使用強型別的編譯式語言。

cues.en: I do lots of work in Python, and I make lots of mistakes in Python.
cues.zh: 我用 Python 做很多工作，也在 Python 裡犯很多錯。

cues.en: And they're pretty easy.
cues.zh: 不過都很容易修正。

cues.en: The first one's over here in config.py.
cues.zh: 第一個在 config.py，

cues.en: We're using or importing .onv, but we never actually used it.
cues.zh: 我們匯入了 dotenv，卻沒有真正使用它。

cues.en: So, of course, we need to call load.onv like that, and that actually reads the environment variables from our .onv file.
cues.zh: 所以當然需要呼叫 load_dotenv()，它才會真正從 .env 檔讀取環境變數。

cues.en: So that was the first mistake, okay?
cues.zh: 這是第一個錯誤。

cues.en: The second mistake is over in llm.py, and again, this would have been caught by a compiler like Go or C, but it's right here on line 36 in my code.
cues.zh: 第二個在 llm.py；像 Go 或 C 的編譯器本來就會抓到這種錯，它位於我這裡的第 36 行。

cues.en: It's not chunk at index zero.
cues.zh: 不是 chunk[0]，

cues.en: It's chunk.choices at index zero, okay?
cues.zh: 而是 chunk.choices[0]。

cues.en: And finally, over in cli.py, here, after I have all these checks for q, if not q, if q in exit, after all these three if statements, of course, I need to actually do something
cues.zh: 最後在 cli.py，完成對 q 的三個 if 判斷，例如 if not q、檢查退出命令之後，當然得真正處理

cues.en: with the user's message.
cues.zh: 使用者的訊息。

cues.en: So I use the variable messages, and I append to that, and then in curly brackets, role
cues.zh: 因此使用 messages 變數，對它呼叫 append，在字典中放入 role，

cues.en: user and content, whatever q is, okay?
cues.zh: 值是 user，content 則是 q 的內容。

cues.en: Without that, the user's question doesn't actually get sent to the LLM at all.
cues.zh: 沒有這一步，使用者的問題根本不會送給 LLM。

cues.en: So three typos, fewer than I expected.
cues.zh: 所以共有三個打字錯誤，比我預期少。

cues.en: In any case, now we're ready to give things a try, and that means we need to do two things.
cues.zh: 總之，現在可以試用了，為此還有兩件事要做。

cues.en: The first one is to open up our .onv file and put some values in here, okay?
cues.zh: 第一件是開啟 .env 檔，在裡面填入設定值。

cues.en: So we need open AI underscore base underscore URL, and that's going to be equal to, well,
cues.zh: 需要 OPENAI_BASE_URL，它的值是——

cues.en: we're using Olama, so it's HTTP colon slash slash localhost colon port 11434 and then slash v1, okay?
cues.zh: 我們使用 Ollama，所以填入 http://localhost:11434/v1。

cues.en: And just so you know, without the v1, you'll still get responses back.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，即使沒有 /v1，仍然會收到回覆，

cues.en: That's Olama's API, but with the slash v1, that actually uses the open AI syntax instead, okay?
cues.zh: 但那是 Ollama 自己的 API；加上 /v1，才會改用 OpenAI 的格式。

cues.en: And we don't need to do this, but I'll put in open AI underscore API underscore key, and I'll just put dummy there, okay? Some value.
cues.zh: 這項其實不是必要的，但我還是加入 OPENAI_API_KEY，值就填 dummy，隨便給個內容。

cues.en: And I could leave that out, and it would use whatever we specified as the default, but I like to keep things as clear as possible.
cues.zh: 也可以省略，讓程式使用先前指定的預設值；不過我喜歡把設定寫清楚。

cues.en: And the last thing we want to specify is our chat model.
cues.zh: 最後要指定聊天模型，

cues.en: And for that, it has to be a capital L. And for that, we specified a default of Gemma3
cues.zh: 也就是 CHAT_MODEL，L 必須大寫。我們之前的預設值是 gemma3:latest，

cues.en: latest, but I'm going to use a different one, QWEN 2.5 colon 7B, okay?
cues.zh: 但這次改用另一個：qwen2.5:7b。

cues.en: And we'll go get that in just a moment.
cues.zh: 等一下就去取得它。

cues.en: Now, the only reason I'm specifying this one, it's a little bit bigger than Gemma3, but it actually follows instructions better, and it's just a better experience, okay?
cues.zh: 選擇這個模型只是因為它比 Gemma 3 稍大，遵循指示的表現也更好，整體使用體驗更佳。

cues.en: And it's entirely up to you which one you use.
cues.zh: 要用哪個模型完全由你決定。

cues.en: So now that we fixed our three typos, or my three typos, you may not have had them, and we specified our values in our .on file, now we have to go get a model.
cues.zh: 現在已經修正三個錯字——是我的錯，你可能沒有——也填好了 .env 的設定，接著取得模型。

cues.en: So let's go over to our web browser, and we'll go to olama.com, and we have to install Olama if we don't have it already, and then we have to go get a model, okay?
cues.zh: 回到瀏覽器，開啟 ollama.com。如果還沒有 Ollama，就先安裝，再下載一個模型。

cues.en: Now, installing it's easy.
cues.zh: 安裝很容易。

cues.en: You can use this right here if you're on a Mac or Linux machine, or you can just scroll to the bottom, click on download, and download an installer for Mac, Linux, or Windows, okay?
cues.zh: 如果用 Mac 或 Linux，可以使用這裡的方式，或捲到最下面點 Download，下載適用於 Mac、Linux 或 Windows 的安裝程式。

cues.en: So install Olama, and then we need a model.
cues.zh: 先裝好 Ollama，接著需要一個模型。

cues.en: So once you have it installed, we're going to go over to models, and we'll look first of all at Gemma3.
cues.zh: 安裝後到 Models，先看看 Gemma 3。

cues.en: So Gemma3, and you see it's this one right here, and we can see how big it is, okay?
cues.zh: 搜尋 Gemma 3，就是這個，可以看到模型大小。

cues.en: So the one we'd get with latest is 3.4B, right there, okay?
cues.zh: 使用 latest 會取得這裡的 Gemma 3 4B。

cues.en: And that is 3.3 gigs or so, and that's a decent size, but a better one, I think, is QWIN 2.5.
cues.zh: 大小約 3.3 GB，算是不錯的尺寸，不過我認為 Qwen 2.5 更合適。

cues.en: It's older, but it will absolutely do the trick.
cues.zh: 它較舊，但完全能完成我們的需求。

cues.en: So let's search for that, and there's QWIN 2.5, and that one, if we scroll down here, the latest is 2.57B. It's bigger.
cues.zh: 搜尋一下，可以找到 Qwen 2.5。往下捲，latest 對應的是 7B，比較大。

cues.en: It's 4.7 gigs, but it will perform better.
cues.zh: 大小是 4.7 GB，但表現會更好。

cues.en: So use whichever one you wish.
cues.zh: 你可以選擇想用的版本。

cues.en: Now, how do you get that?
cues.zh: 那要怎麼取得？

cues.en: Well, let's go back to our IDE, and open our terminal, and type olama, assuming you have
cues.zh: 回到 IDE、開啟終端機，假設已經安裝

cues.en: it installed, olama pull, and I'm going to pull QWIN 2.5 colon 7B.
cues.zh: Ollama，就輸入 ollama pull qwen2.5:7b。

cues.en: I already have that, but it will take a little while to download, depending on how fast your connection to the internet is, okay?
cues.zh: 我已經有了，但實際下載需要一些時間，取決於網路連線速度。

cues.en: So download that, and once it's installed, there's one more step to follow, okay?
cues.zh: 下載安裝好後，還要再做一步。

cues.en: So after it's downloaded, execute this command, olama serve, and what that does is it starts
cues.zh: 下載完成後執行 ollama serve，它會在

cues.en: up olama in the background, listening on the URL we specified, the one that's right here in our .on file, okay?
cues.zh: 背景啟動 Ollama，監聽我們在 .env 裡指定的 URL。

cues.en: Now I already have this running, but I can still execute the command.
cues.zh: 我已經啟動了，但仍可以再執行這個指令。

cues.en: It'll just tell me that it's already working, okay?
cues.zh: 它只會告訴我服務已經在執行。

cues.en: You can see right here it says, bind address already in use.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到 bind address already in use，表示位址已被使用。

cues.en: For you, it should give a message saying it started up, and without starting it, you're not going to be able to connect to the LLM.
cues.zh: 你的畫面應該會顯示服務已啟動；若沒啟動，就無法連接 LLM。

cues.en: Now the obvious question is, I've started it, how do I stop it?
cues.zh: 很自然的問題是：啟動之後要怎麼停止？

cues.en: And the answer is, at least as I record this, you can't stop it, but that's not a big deal.
cues.zh: 答案是，至少在錄製這段影片時，無法停止，不過這不算什麼大問題。

cues.en: The way that this works is it will start listening, and if it doesn't get a request after a few minutes, it just goes to sleep until it gets another request, okay?
cues.zh: 它的運作方式是持續監聽；幾分鐘沒有請求時就會進入休眠，直到收到下一個請求。

cues.en: And it consumes almost no system resources while it's sleeping.
cues.zh: 休眠時幾乎不會耗用系統資源。

cues.en: So that means also the very first time you make a request to the LLM, if it's asleep, there'll be a pause while it wakes everything up, okay?
cues.zh: 因此，如果模型正在休眠，第一次送出請求時會稍作停頓，等待所有東西喚醒。

cues.en: But in any case, once you've pulled a model, and once you've started OLAMA Serve, we should be able now to type PyREG, okay?
cues.zh: 總之，下載好模型並啟動 ollama serve 後，現在應該就能輸入 pyrag。

cues.en: And there it is.
cues.zh: 畫面出來了。

cues.en: Now make sure you're in a virtual environment like I am, okay?
cues.zh: 記得要像我一樣，先進入虛擬環境。

cues.en: And it says we're using the model QUEN 2.57B, type your question, commands, reset to clear history, exit to quit.
cues.zh: 畫面顯示目前使用 qwen2.5:7b，請輸入問題；/reset 可清除歷史紀錄，/exit 可離開。

cues.en: Let's give it a try.
cues.zh: 來試試看。

cues.en: What is the capital city of Australia?
cues.zh: 澳洲的首都是哪裡？

cues.en: It should know that.
cues.zh: 它應該知道答案。

cues.en: And there'll be a pause.
cues.zh: 這裡會稍微等一下。

cues.en: Now right now it's thinking, oh, that was actually pretty fast, maybe because I just typed OLAMA Serve and got a response, but it gave me an answer.
cues.zh: 它正在思考。其實非常快，可能因為我剛輸入 ollama serve 並得到回應，所以很快就給出了答案。

cues.en: The one thing that's a bit of a UI problem is once I type this command, while it's formulating its response, we should give some kind of spinner or visual feedback just to let the
cues.zh: 介面還有個小問題：輸入指令後，在模型組織回覆時，應該顯示某種旋轉指示器或視覺回饋，讓

cues.en: user know that something's going on.
cues.zh: 使用者知道程式正在處理。

cues.en: So we'll take care of that later on.
cues.zh: 這點之後會處理。

cues.en: The nice thing is this actually works.
cues.zh: 好消息是，它確實能運作。

cues.en: So I asked it that question.
cues.zh: 剛才問了那個問題，

cues.en: Let's see what else we can ask it.
cues.zh: 看看還能問什麼。

cues.en: Give me the names of three Greek gods.
cues.zh: 請告訴我三位希臘神祇的名字。

cues.en: And that was pretty fast, okay?
cues.zh: 這次也很快。

cues.en: So clearly this works the way that it should.
cues.zh: 顯然程式有按照預期運作。

cues.en: Let's try exiting, exit.
cues.zh: 試著離開，輸入 /exit。

cues.en: And it quit out. Perfect.
cues.zh: 它退出了，很好。

cues.en: So now we know we can connect to an LLM and have a chat with it.
cues.zh: 現在知道可以連接 LLM 並與它聊天。

cues.en: So now we can start working on the various parts of REG.
cues.zh: 接著就能開始處理 RAG 的各個部分，

cues.en: And that will be the retriever that goes and gets information from a vector store.
cues.zh: 包括到向量儲存區取得資訊的檢索器、

cues.en: It will be the vector store itself.
cues.zh: 向量儲存區本身，

cues.en: And it'll be the rewriter that rewrites the user's prompt and gives it more information before actually sending it to the LLM.
cues.zh: 以及改寫使用者提示詞的改寫器，在送給 LLM 前補充更多資訊。

cues.en: And we'll get started on that in the next section.
cues.zh: 下一節就開始處理這些內容。
